tool_args.rationale: The response is concave over the sampled u_now range, while the open-branch rows establish strong gradient-linked suppression. Fit a saturating substrate response plus a linear gradient sink and square-root local contribution; estimate all four coefficients numerically from the paid rows. No high-gradient avalanche probe is indicated because the largest sampled s_grad is below its stated threshold.

considered_alternatives.option: Acquire another open-branch or fine-trajectory probe
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The existing rows span three gradient regimes and seven response values; this is sufficient to fit a compact, numerically estimated saturation-plus-gradient-sink model without another measurement.
It cannot explain the large output change between nearby u_now values when s_grad changes from 0.18 to 2.35.
A simple monotone power law does not explain the observed concavity in u_now together with the strong gradient-dependent suppression.
